lockedDoors.locationName: Door Between Left and Right Entrances

strats.name: Precise Bonk Boost
note: It is possible to boost across with several precise boosts.

strats.name: Boomerang
note: Hit the switch with a boomerang to save bombs.
In the hookshot room, throw the boomerang up and move to the side to easily hit the switch.
The next room can be done a similar way with the Red Boomerang.
With a Blue Boomerang and Hookshot, quickly hookshot the pot to move over fast enough.
This is possible with the Blue Boomerang alone; stand just south of the door, a few pixels from the rail
and where Link's back is roughly centered with the left post of the doorframe; throw the boomerang diagonally and immediately move to the right.

strats.name: Boomerang
note: While south of the door, throw the boomerang to the left, delay breifly, then go north.
The delay is helpful to prevent double hitting the switch.
In the next room, throw the boomerang north then move to the side to hit the switch.
devNote: Assumes the blue pegs are down, which is safe if the dungeon is not randomized.

strats.name: Bonk Boost
note: Lift one pot then bonk boost off of the other to the right. Be sure not to accidentally pick up both pots.

strats.name: Ether
note: Use Ether multiple times to briefly see the walkway.

strats.name: Red Cane Guidance
note: Use many red cane blocks to ensure that Link never falls off an edge.
Push the blocks slowly, and if the block falls, immediately stop and place a block in a different direction.

strats.name: Bow and Pots
note: Kill the Stalfos and Helmasaur and hit the Red Bari twice with the bow and then other two with the pots.
The mini Red Bari can be particularly annoying to hit.
The Blue Hardhat is vulnerable to silver arrows, so with them save both pots for the mini Red Bari.

strats.name: Rod and Pots
note: Kill the Stalfos and Red Bari with the rod and the other two with the pots.

strats.name: Bombs and Pots
note: Place bombs strategically to try to hit multiple enemies at a time while several enemies are still alive.
Afterwards, target them specifically by placing them directly in their prison.
The Blue Hardhat Beetle is not vulnerable to bombs; kill it and another enemy with the pots.

strats.name: Red Cane and Pots
note: It is possible to do this with a single red cane block, but requires hitting the enemies in a specific way.
It is best to kill the Stalfos and the Red Bari while never letting the firey Winder touch the block.
Placing the block while north of the stalfos can help hit it while still being able to pick it up.
Use pots to kill the remaining two enemies.

strats.name: Blue Cane and Pots
note: Kill the Helmasaur and Red Bari with the cane and the other two with the pots.

strats.name: Hookshot Red Bari
note: Use the Hookshot to kill the Red Bari through the wall, it requires fairly precise positioning of the enemy, so it might take several shots.
Note that Boomerang can also kill the Stalfos.

strats.name: Lamp Only
note: After entering the room from the north door, Bomb boost across the pit, light the torch with the lamp and immediately fall into the hole.
Hold right to be aligned with the first torch. This is barely possible with either Hookshot or Pegasus Boots to quickly move across the conveyors.

strats.name: Base
note: Hit the switch with bombs or the red cane.

strats.name: Armos Knights - Sword (L1-L2)
devNote: The Master Sword does less damage than the Fighter Sword, so these numbers are for the Master Sword.

strats.name: Armos Knights - Sword (L1 or L3)
devNote: The L1 and L3 swords are equally strong, but the Master Sword is weaker.
If Link has the L1 sword and full health, this will not have canRiskPermanentLossOfAccess,
because the fight consumes fewer resources with the Master Sword and full health with sparkles.

strats.name: Armos Knights - Fire or Ice Rod
Eyegore Kill
note: It's generally easier to dodge the spikes if the orange pegs remain down.

strats.name: Eyegore Tank or Dodge
note: It's generally easier to dodge the spikes if the orange pegs remain down.

strats.name: Lanmolas - Bow
note: Lanmolas can be very difficult to hit with arrows.

strats.name: Lanmolas - Bombs
note: When multiple are still alive, center the bomb in the room and time it to explode when the Lanmolas will be vulnerable.
When only one is remaining, throw the Bombs at the Lanmola.

strats.name: Base - Moldorm Already Defeated
note: The Moldorm fight can be skipped if the chest has been opened on a previous climb.
